# changedetection_tags (Data Source)

Fetches the list of tags.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "changedetection_tags" "all" {
}

output "example" {
  value = data.changedetection_tags.all
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `tags` (Attributes Map) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--tags))

<a id="nestedatt--tags"></a>
### Nested Schema for `tags`

Read-Only:

- `date_created` (Number) The date at which the tag was created (seconds since Jan 1 1970).
- `id` (String) Tag Id.
- `notification_muted` (Boolean) True if notifications are muted for this tag.
- `title` (String) The title of the tag.
